turns.prompt: Has anyone in Slack said anything about a hard deadline for the spacing migration?

replies.text: Checking Slack discussions for any mention of a deadline for the spacing migration…

I wasn't able to search workspace Slack channels directly (workspace search is unavailable in this turn without a triggering event token), so I can't confirm what may have been discussed informally in Slack chat. 

However, looking at our documented design sources:

- **Roadmap Card:** The work is tracked under [Spacing Token Migration](https://app.notion.com/p/Spacing-Token-Migration-26bb7cca49828002a07ee3bd6c5bfc4c) (RM-1911, `Universal` pillar), contributed by Ashley Xu and Bryan Huang. Its `Design Status` is marked `Shipped`, while `Dev Status` sits in `Dev Backlog`.
- **Card PRD & Guide:** The card content serves as the Spacing Token Guide (defining primitives vs. semantic tokens, gap, and padding usage rules) and does not state any target date or hard deadline.
- **Decisions & Notes:** Neither the Decisions DB (54 rows scanned) nor Design Running Notes (103 rows scanned) records a deadline or milestone decision for this migration.

I checked the Roadmap board, the card PRD, and the Decisions DB just now, so this documentation status is current. 

If someone shared a deadline in a specific Slack thread, drop the message link here and I can read the thread directly—or check in with <https://www.linkedin.com/in/boyuang/|Bill Guo> (Design Lead) or Ashley and Bryan to see if an engineering timeline was agreed upon outside the card.
